name: bara-marketing-site
description: barastep.com — Vue 3 + Vite + shadcn-vue marketing site. Builds to web/dist, which the Express backend serves as static files (see src/app.js). Deliberately its own package.json: none of these deps belong in the backend's runtime dependency tree.

scripts.build: npm run theme && npm run reviews && vite build && node scripts/prerender.mjs && node scripts/check-build-output.mjs
